segments.sn35.142:1.2: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo cakkhussa uppādāya, sopi anattā.
segments.sn35.142:1.3: Anattasambhūtaṃ, bhikkhave, cakkhu kuto attā bhavissati … pe …
segments.sn35.142:1.5: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo jivhāya uppādāya, sopi anattā.
segments.sn35.142:1.6: Anattasambhūtā, bhikkhave, jivhā kuto attā bhavissati … pe …
segments.sn35.142:1.8: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo manassa uppādāya, sopi anattā.
segments.sn35.142:1.9: Anattasambhūto, bhikkhave, mano kuto attā bhavissati!
segments.sn35.142:1.10: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe …‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.

lines: 137-145. Catutthaṃ suddhikaṃ katvā desiyamāne bujjhanakānaṃ ajjhāsayena vuttaṃ.
Pañcamādīni tathā tathā bujjhantānaṃ ajjhāsayena vuttāni.
Tathā tathāti ajjhattikāni bāhirāni ca āyatanāni aniccalakkhaṇena dukkhānattalakkhaṇehi ca yojetvā dassanavasena.
